CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content sets (red positions) and explicit origin/representation status are provided for the same referents (current and candidate entries), satisfying content, organization/access and differentiation bindings.

A.rationale: No explicit attention or allocation relation is stated linking an allocation/change to the identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify sets of positions for color attributes (red/blue) for named referents.

D.rationale: The report separately provides content identifiers (color position sets) and distinct status/organization fields (origin/representation metadata) for the same referents.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/representation metadata describes how each content entry is organized/presented (completed_record, inherited_current, native_conditional_record), i.e. presentation/access status.
